critical_code_review_comments: Nav.jsx now uses `absolute inset-x-0 top-0` so it scrolls with page as requested. Confirmed working. If a sticky header is ever desired again, change back to `fixed`.

Framer-motion console warning: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position' from useScroll in Hero.jsx target=ref (hero section is `relative` so this is safe, but the ref element may be evaluated before mount — low-impact nit).

`pillar-${p.n}` data-testid is placed only on the small number element, not the card root. Future test authors should assert against the parent (`[data-testid='pillar-01']`.parent.innerText). Consider moving the testid to the Reveal/card root for clarity.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Lenis smooth scroll is active; use window.__lenis.scrollTo(y) and wait ~2-2.5s before asserting positions. Header is now `absolute` so after scroll the DOM header getBoundingClientRect().top goes negative — correct behavior per request. pillar-01 testid is on the number child only, assert parent innerText.
